title: The Country Mile
description: Travel a country mile from village outskirts through fields, a working farm, a river bridge and a distant rolling lane.

signs.text:
The village outskirts
Pass the last village fences

The long fields
The fields break around drainage ditches

The working farm
Thread the farm’s loading sheds

The country river crossing
Use the travelling bridge before the final lane

The distant rolling lane
Follow the country mile over its last hill
